nodes.description: Public ERC1155 token id (40) of the auctioned asset
Address of the ERC1155 token contract used for transfers
Flag marking whether the auction has been finalised
Timestamp at which bidding opens
Payable address receiving the protocol fee
Payable address of the seller / NFT owner
Duration of the extended bidding window (24 hours)
Total auction duration from startBidTime (24 hours)
Amount of the current highest bid
Timestamp of the most recent bid
Payable address of the current highest bidder
Constructor initialising token address, id, start time, seller and haus
Payable bid function that refunds the previous bidder and records the new highest bid
Finalises the auction: sends ERC1155 to winner, splits fee to haus and pays seller
Fallback finalisation that returns the ERC1155 to the seller when no bids were placed
View helper reporting whether the auction is still live
ERC1155 receiver hook returning the acceptance selector
msg.sender: externally controlled bidder address
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time used for all auction phase checks
tx.origin: used to block contract bidders
winning.transfer(lastBid): external ETH refund to the previous bidder executed before state update
haus.transfer(hausFee): external ETH fee payout to the protocol address
seller.transfer(address(this).balance): external ETH payout of remaining balance
IERC1155(token).safeTransferFrom(this, winning, id, 1, data) in end(): external token call before balance is read
IERC1155(token).safeTransferFrom(this, seller, id, 1, data) in pull(): external token call
_start: auction start timestamp passed to the constructor
_seller: payable seller address passed to the constructor
_haus: payable fee-recipient address passed to the constructor
balance: snapshot of address(this).balance taken inside end()
hausFee: 3/20 of the contract balance computed inside end()

edges.reason: bid() gates acceptance on block.timestamp relative to startBidTime, auctionLength and lastBidTime
end() checks block.timestamp against lastBidTime+bidLength and startBidTime+auctionLength before payout
pull() requires block.timestamp >= startBidTime+auctionLength to release the NFT
live() compares block.timestamp with bid and auction deadlines
msg.sender becomes the winning bidder and defines the refund target of the next bid
bid() relies on msg.sender == tx.origin as its only anti-contract guard
constructor hard-codes id = 40
constructor hard-codes the ERC1155 token address
constructor writes startBidTime from the _start parameter
constructor writes the seller address
constructor writes the haus fee address
constructor sets the opening lastBid to 0.5 ether
bid() overwrites lastBid with msg.value after the refund
bid() assigns winning = msg.sender
bid() records lastBidTime = block.timestamp
bid() reads bidLength to bound the refund window
bid() reads auctionLength to bound the whole auction
ending the auction flips ended, which stops further bidding state transitions
end() reads lastBidTime to verify at least one bid exists and the window elapsed
end() reads auctionLength for the hard deadline check
end() emits the winning amount from lastBid
end() sets ended = true as the terminal state update
ended flag guards end() against repeated finalisation
ended flag guards pull() against repeated finalisation
pull() reads startBidTime for the deadline check
pull() reads auctionLength for the deadline check
pull() sets ended = true after returning the NFT
live() reads lastBidTime
live() reads bidLength
live() reads startBidTime
live() reads auctionLength
bid() performs an external ETH transfer to the previous winner before updating lastBid/winning/lastBidTime
the ETH refund re-enters the bidder context with lastBidTime and winning still stale
end() calls the external ERC1155 contract before computing the ETH payouts and setting ended
the ERC1155 safeTransferFrom hook can re-enter end() while ended is still false
end() forwards the 3/20 fee to the external haus address
end() forwards the remaining balance to the external seller address
pull() invokes the external ERC1155 contract before setting ended
end() reads the token state variable as the external call target
end() passes the winning address as the ERC1155 recipient
pull() reads the token state variable as the external call target
pull() passes the seller address as the ERC1155 recipient

normalization_plan.reason: _start is only consumed to initialise the startBidTime state variable inside the constructor
_seller is only consumed to initialise the seller state variable inside the constructor
_haus is only consumed to initialise the haus state variable inside the constructor
balance only exists to size the final seller.transfer payout and can be folded into that unsafe operation
hausFee is computed solely to feed haus.transfer(hausFee) and can be folded into that unsafe operation
